guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：量子通訊網路測試平台
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Quantum-communication network testbeds
guides.concept: 以量子光鏈路、糾纏與古典控制平面串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect quantum optical links, entanglement and classical control planes through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
procedure: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「量子與古典資源」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：量子狀態與古典控制資訊有不同複製限制。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定光源，只改單臂光損耗。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「不可複製原理」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「糾纏分發」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：糾纏建立需要可定義成功事件與品質。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定光源，只改單臂光損耗。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「Coincidence」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「偵測效率」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：雙端有效率乘積限制可觀測配對事件。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留損耗，只改暗計數與 coincidence 窗口。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「時間標籤」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「量子記憶」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：保存時間須涵蓋等待與協議回饋延遲。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較有與沒有古典時間標籤的資料。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「交換與中繼」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「共纖雜訊」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：古典光通道可能以散射雜訊影響量子通道。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬記憶保存時間短於協議等待時間。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「QKD 與量子網」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「平台驗收」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：光損耗、時間誤差與狀態品質須分別交付。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬記憶保存時間短於協議等待時間。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「量子與古典資源」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around quantum/classical resources, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Quantum states and classical control information have different copying constraints. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix source rate and vary one-arm loss. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat no-cloning principle as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around entanglement distribution, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Entanglement establishment needs defined success events and quality. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix source rate and vary one-arm loss. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat coincidence measurements as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around detection efficiency, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: The product of endpoint efficiencies limits observed paired events. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix loss and vary dark counts/coincidence window. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat time tags as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around quantum memories, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Memory lifetime must cover waiting and protocol-feedback delay. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare records with/without classical time tags. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat swapping and repeaters as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around coexistence noise, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Classical optical channels can affect quantum channels through scattering noise. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model memory lifetime shorter than protocol waiting time. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat qkd versus quantum networks as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around testbed acceptance, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Report optical loss, timing error and state quality separately. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model memory lifetime shorter than protocol waiting time. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat quantum/classical resources as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
evidence: 提交「可重現模擬」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
提交「平台驗收」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
提交「平台驗收」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
evidenceEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for reproducible simulation. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for testbed acceptance. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

pitfalls: 產生糾纏就能省略所有古典通訊。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
pitfallsEn: Entanglement generation eliminates all classical communication. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.

guides.scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
guides.scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

courses.overview: 由量子光鏈路、糾纏與古典控制平面連結兩個已編寫的相鄰專業；相似方法不表示性能數值、權限或介面可以直接沿用。
courses.overviewEn: Connect quantum optical links, entanglement and classical control planes to two authored neighboring domains; shared methods do not make metrics, permissions or interfaces interchangeable.

related.title: 深空延遲容忍網路
related.why: 可移植「量子與古典資源」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from quantum/classical resources; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.transfer: 可移植「量子與古典資源」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from quantum/classical resources; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理量子光鏈路、糾纏與古典控制平面；「深空延遲容忍網路」主要處理儲存攜帶轉送、接觸計畫與資料壽命，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes quantum optical links, entanglement and classical control planes; Deep-space delay-tolerant networking emphasizes store-carry-forward, contact plans and data lifetime. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「量子通訊網路測試平台」與「深空延遲容忍網路」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「Coincidence」的對照方法至「持久儲存」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Quantum-communication network testbeds and Deep-space delay-tolerant networking flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from coincidence measurements to persistent storage, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.

roles.roleEn: Develops QKD and quantum networking, including via its ID Quantique acquisition.
roles.business: 開發離子阱量子電腦，並經由 ID Quantique 等收購發展量子網路。
roles.businessEn: Builds trapped-ion quantum computers and, via acquisitions such as ID Quantique, quantum networking.

roles.role: 投入量子網路與糾纏分發研究。
roles.roleEn: Invests in quantum-networking and entanglement-distribution research.
roles.business: 供應路由器、交換器、企業 Wi-Fi 與資安（Duo、Splunk）方案。
roles.businessEn: Supplies routers, switches, enterprise Wi-Fi and security (Duo, Splunk).

courses.connection: 從「量子通訊網路測試平台」的材料、設備、設計、量測或系統整合問題，延伸查閱下列公司與機構的官方資料；這是教材關聯，不代表合作、採購、背書或投資建議。
courses.connectionEn: Explore official information from companies and institutions related to the materials, equipment, design, measurement or system integration in Quantum-communication network testbeds. This is a learning association, not a partnership, procurement, endorsement or investment advice.

vendors.businessEn: Public architecture/context; course models, diagrams and assumed exercises are independently authored, not source measurements.
